overview: Coronado Springs is a large Moderate resort inspired by Mexico and the American Southwest, set around a big lake. It's also Disney's main convention hotel, and the Gran Destino Tower adds upscale rooms and a rooftop restaurant.
suits: Couples, adults and families who want Moderate prices with more upscale dining, especially in the Gran Destino Tower.
rooms: Standard rooms sleep four. The Gran Destino Tower has more modern rooms and suites with higher views.
pools: The main pool, the Dig Site, has a Mayan-style pyramid, a waterslide and a kids' area. There are quieter pools around the lake.
dining: Toledo – Tapas, Steak & Seafood sits at the top of Gran Destino Tower, and Three Bridges Bar & Grill is on the lake. El Mercado de Coronado is the quick-service option.
gettingAround: Every park is reached by Disney bus. The resort has several internal bus stops.
pros: Strong dining for a Moderate resort
Gran Destino Tower rooms and views
cons: Very spread out around the lake
tips: Request a room near the main building or in Gran Destino Tower if you don't want long walks.
Go up to Toledo's lounge for views, even if you don't eat there.
bestFor: Couples and adults who want Moderate prices with upscale touches.
